PARMCHK.DAT and PARM_BLBA_GAFF2.DAT are copied unchanged from AmberTools 26
(dat/antechamber/; ambertools26_rc7.tar.bz2, SHA-256
5d46eef3c2bb7d5bf9e8c0c38add34406ea67e3f0e4097ac9d11d8a544538c9c).

They are part of AmberTools and are distributed under the GNU General Public
License, version 3: AmberTools-LICENSE.txt, copied unchanged from
AmberTools/LICENSE, holds the GPL text. That file's public-domain exception
covers only the force field parameter files in dat/leap (such as gaff2.dat),
not these two files.

The package reads them as data (parmchk.py, bonded_substitution.py). The rest
of the package is under the MIT License (LICENSE and NOTICE at the top of
the project).
